doc:
If two lists are identical except for having their first two elements swapped, then they are
permutations of each other: `x::y::l ~ y::x::l`.
name: List.Perm.swap
typeText:
∀ {α : Type u} (x y : α) (l : List.{u} α),
  List.Perm.{u} (List.cons.{u} y (List.cons.{u} x l)) (List.cons.{u} x (List.cons.{u} y l))

source.code:
/--
  If two lists are identical except for having their first two elements swapped, then they are
  permutations of each other: `x::y::l ~ y::x::l`.
  -/
  | swap (x y : α) (l : List α) : Perm (y :: x :: l) (x :: y :: l)
